region.name: Postgres Scaling And Outbox Contention
region.summary: Covers the primary Postgres database's capacity and reliability work, from sharding-readiness plans and trigger metrics to load testing and fixing ACH outbox vacuum contention.

brief.text:
**What this region covers**
Capacity planning and reliability for the primary Postgres database (db.r6i.4xlarge). It centers on a pre-decision sharding plan and on the ACH outbox contention incident, including load-test procedure.

**Recent changes**
- Latest quarterly check: 151k MAU (120k when the plan was written), ~1.1TB, 34% peak CPU, 52ms p99, replica lag in seconds. No sharding trigger has been hit.
- The June load test failed from vacuum contention on ach_outbox. All fixes are done:
  - ach_outbox is now insert-only and day-partitioned.
  - Mutable state moved to a narrow ach_entries table.
  - The shadow diff moved to a read replica.
  - Autovacuum was tuned.
- The re-test passed at 3x volume with an 11ms p99 claim latency.

**Decisions**
- Defer horizontal sharding. Exhaust Phase 0 (replicas, query optimization, events partitioning, separate events cluster) and Phase 1 (vertical sharding) first. Horizontal sharding by user_id (likely Citus) happens only if needed.
- Events go to a separate cluster from day one of the next migration.
- Shard-readiness rules apply now: user_id on new user-scoped tables, no cross-user joins, minimal cross-table foreign keys.

**Open questions**
- Would moving the round-up sweep (~20k entries/day, still on Sidekiq) into the outbox pipeline require revisiting partition sizing? It would more than double daily entry count.
- Which trigger will be hit first, and will Series B or the investing feature change load?
- Will additional money-moving jobs in Q4 change the write profile?
- Outbox dead-tuple buildup at 3x remains a tracked low-severity risk.

**Suggested next steps**
- Dry-run the runbook with a simulated SFTP outage (due 2026-10-23).
- Run the next quarterly sharding check (scheduled for December).
- Write the Outbox Vacuum Contention Analysis.

items.title: Decision: Defer horizontal sharding; exhaust Phase 0 and Phase 1 first
items.summary: Plan is to buy time with replicas, query optimization, partitioning and a separate events cluster, then vertically shard; horizontal sharding by user_id (Citus) only if Phase 1 isn't enough.
